svg.title: Qwen and Nanbeige: saved prompt token-counter p50/p95
svg.desc: Separate zero-based panels for Qwen reported prompt counts and Nanbeige total input, cached and fresh counts. Qwen fresh/cache split unavailable, not zero. Independent percentiles are not additive. Fresh panel axis 0 to 1000, others 0 to 14000; no cross-runtime prefill throughput ranking.
svg.title: Qwen and Nanbeige: saved prompt token-counter p50/p95

g.text: Prompt counters · not a prefill race

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d5966

g.text: Qwen3.5 9B Q4_K_M / Ollama · Nanbeige4.3-33B IQ2_M / llama.cpp

text.style: font-size: 9.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566170

g.text: Qwen fresh/cache split: UNAVAILABLE, not zero. Its reported count is not a matched fresh-token metric.

text.style: font-size: 9.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566170

g.text: Nanbeige per call: input = cached + fresh. Independent p50/p95 values are NOT additive; no stacked bars.

text.style: font-size: 9.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566170

g.text: Separate zero-based axes: fresh-token panel uses 0–1,000; other panels use 0–14,000.

text.style: font-size: 9.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566170

g.text: Counts depend on tokenizer, history and cache/order. No comparable prefill tokens/second ranking.

text.style: font-size: 9.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566170

g.text: 7 Nov 2026 text pilot · completed calls only · one capped attempt retained separately · no inference rerun.
